title: Cholera Rapid Test with Enrichment Step Has Diagnostic Performance Equivalent to Culture
author: Lameck N. Ontweka
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Collect stool specimen
steps.instruction: Obtain a fresh stool sample from each suspected cholera case using a sterile container.

steps.title: Enrich sample for RDT
steps.instruction: Inoculate the stool into alkaline peptone water (APW) and mix thoroughly.

substeps.instruction: Use the Crystal VC rapid diagnostic test (RDT) kit (Span Diagnostics, India) as the source of APW if supplied, otherwise add sterile APW.
Ensure the stool‑to‑APW ratio follows the kit’s recommendation (not specified in the text).

steps.title: Incubate enrichment broth
steps.instruction: Incubate the APW‑stool mixture at ambient temperature for 4 ± 6 hours.

steps.title: Run Crystal VC rapid test
steps.instruction: After incubation, perform the Crystal VC RDT on the enriched sample according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare culture specimen
steps.instruction: Inoculate a wet filter paper with the stool sample for culture.

substeps.instruction: Place a small amount of stool onto the wet filter paper and allow it to absorb.
Proceed to culture the inoculated wet filter paper using standard cholera culture methods (not detailed in the text).

steps.title: Prepare PCR specimens
steps.instruction: Inoculate dry Whatman 903 filter paper with stool and also collect supernatant from the wet filter paper for PCR.

substeps.instruction: Apply stool onto a dry Whatman 903 filter paper and let it dry.
After the wet filter paper culture step, recover the liquid supernatant.
Use both the dried filter paper and the wet‑filter‑paper supernatant as templates for PCR detection of Vibrio cholerae O1.

steps.title: Perform PCR detection
steps.instruction: Carry out PCR for Vibrio cholerae O1 on DNA extracted from the dry Whatman 903 filter paper and the wet filter paper supernatant.
